layers.name: FX quote / spread
layers.what: Difference between the executable CNY-to-USD rate and a reference rate, plus any provider margin.
layers.verified: BOC indicative board at 2026-11-09 09:15:45 China time: bid 666.38 / ask 669.19 / reference 671.88 per USD100. Round-trip bid/ask gap is about 0.42%; ask was below the reference, so this does not prove a one-way conversion loss. Actual transaction rate controls.

layers.name: Sender commission and cable/postage
layers.what: Published bank or provider charges to send the money.
layers.verified: BOC TT: 0.1% min CNY50/max CNY260 + CNY150 cable. HSBC Premier/Advance: 0.1% min100/max500 + CNY120 cable; private-banking individual commission/cable free. HSBC Global Transfer Advance actual USD20/transfer; PB/Premier free.

layers.name: Correspondent / receiver / downstream charges
layers.what: Intermediary and receiving-bank deductions, cash deposit/collection fees, ATM surcharges.
layers.verified: BOC and HSBC tariffs exclude other institutions' charges; BOC optional USD full-arrival is USD15/25 only on qualifying intermediary routes. Actual amounts unknown.

layers.name: Documentation and approval costs
layers.what: Tax certificates, notarisation/apostille where required, translation, agent fees, SAFE approval time.
layers.verified: SAFE emigrant/inheritance administrative approval itself is published as no-fee; document/agent costs are not published and remain blank.

layers.name: Underlying income/property tax
layers.what: PRC IIT/EIT/VAT/withholding on the income or gain that created the balance; not a wire fee.
layers.verified: Housing gain generally 20% of net gain (or assessed 1%-3% where applicable); foreign-individual FIE dividends 20% from 2026-09-01; nonresident corporate specified income reduced 10% EIT. Personalized amounts blank.

layers.name: U.S. tax and reporting exposure
layers.what: Worldwide income reporting, personal FX gain, FBAR/FATCA/3520 duties and penalties for non-compliance.
layers.verified: Personal FX gain above USD200 is reported as capital gain per IRS Pub. 525; §988 disapplies the personal exclusion for that transaction. Current eCFR table shows nonwillful FBAR maximum USD16,536 and willful adjusted amount USD165,353 for penalties assessed on/after 2025-01-17; willful may instead use 50% of the account balance. These are ceilings, not transfer fees or predicted charges.

layers.name: Illegal-route penalties (rejected)
layers.what: Administrative/criminal exposure for evasion, underground dealing, fake documents or crypto settlement.
layers.verified: PRC FX Regulation penalties can reach 30% and, in serious cases, 30%-100% of the amount for specified violations. Current PBOC Yinfa [2026] No. 42 prohibits virtual-currency exchange business and repealed the 2021 notice. These are legal exposures, not prices.
